verdict.rationale: Factory documents session isolation via separate working directories/worktrees (factory-docs-23), BYOM machine registration (factory-docs-24), and tiered autonomy that gates operations before they run (factory-docs-7, factory-docs-18), which together provide some sandboxing of agent actions from a user's main work. However there is no explicit mention of a dedicated sandbox/staging environment or guarantee that agent actions cannot touch production databases or live data. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox/staging environment distinct from production, guarantees against touching production data stores, and independent verification of this isolation.
